card.name: Words right after money terms
card.fires_on: The word right after a money word or amount, such as money, dollar, euro, funds or a currency figure. It is often a following noun or a linking word like from or in.

modes.label: Money compounds
modes.description: The second part of a phrase built on money, dollar or euro.
modes.example: that dollar<< bill>> in your pocket today would be worth only

modes.label: Link after an amount
modes.description: A linking word such as from or in right after a sum of money or a funds term.
modes.example: He took a loan of 12,000 taka ($174)<< from>> a local organization.

card.plain: It lights up on the word that follows a money term, like the 'bill' in 'dollar bill' or 'from' after a loan amount.
